title: Luxuriant Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich and spicy tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, ginger, garlic, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the lamb or beef stock, chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
